judgment.rationale: Both are Content SFIs under the same Competency C-4.2 ("Selects and uses suitable units and tools for measuring different attributes of the objects") and Curricular Goal CG-4 (measuring attributes with standard/non-standard units). The Class-3 item concerns length measurement in metre/half metre/quarter metre with a measuring tape (LCs: measure lengths in metres, half and quarter metre, compare more/less than 1 metre); the Class-5 item concerns measuring the weight of small objects in milligrams with a weighing balance. They are coherent complementary strands of standard-unit measurement with attribute-appropriate tools and finer sub-units, but the attribute (length vs weight), unit system, and instrument differ entirely, so the earlier length work is not specifically enabling for milligram weighing beyond generic measurement habits. That is meaningful same-domain reinforcement rather than a justified developmental dependency, so a Class-3 to Class-5 buildsTowards is not supported; symmetric relatesTo is recorded. Only nomination signals were a shared ancestor pair, a single shared LC tag ("measurement"), generic token/trigram overlap ("measuring", "using"), and same-page proximity, which do not by themselves establish direction.

judgment.rationale: Both are Class-5 Content statements (identical rank 4) under the same Competency C-2.3 (four basic operations) and Curricular Goal CG-2. The first covers understanding powers of 10 and performing all four operations on them (LCs: add/subtract/multiply/divide powers of 10); the second specifies multi-digit division cases (3-digit by 2-digit, 4-digit by 2-digit, 4-digit by 1-digit). The overlap is substantive rather than merely lexical: place-value/powers-of-10 reasoning and division operate on the same whole-number operation domain and mutually reinforce each other (e.g. estimating partial quotients using multiples of 10). However, neither statement's text asserts that one is a scope extension or increased-complexity successor of the other, and same-rank placement provides no direction; the division statement is a distinct case set, not a deepening of powers-of-10 work. Meaningful same-topic coherence without justified developmental dependency supports a symmetric relatesTo. Evidence is bounded: both endpoints' source evidence is truncated (33 omitted items each) and both carry merge context, but the retained descriptions and LCs are sufficient for this symmetric judgment.

The Class-4 item (rank 3) is 'Fractions by Paper-folding', whose LC specifies representing commonly used fractions such as 1/2 and 1/4 as parts of a whole by paper-folding.
